target: Durable Capture Core recovery, source-local fault isolation, bounded health, and real-effect release evidence.
invariants: The WAL contains only transaction metadata and hashes and never replaces human-readable raw authority.
A cursor advances only after the corresponding archive mutation is durable.
Optional telemetry, control, summary, index, exchange, environment, project, UI, and AI failures cannot stop capture.
allowed_changes: Add bounded internal WAL prepare, commit, recovery, and compaction evidence.
Add source-local failure isolation, pure-read health, nonzero failure exits, and P0 release scenarios.
prohibited_changes: Write dialogue content into the WAL or use it as a new source of truth.
Change raw bytes, summary rules, atomic summary work, historical backfill, or cloud protocols.
